doc: FBL 0.12, section 4.9 (comments, FBL 0.11), FR-001: etalii.adp.ide.standalone/src/diagrams/wardley-map/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.WardleyMap.Tests/Fixtures/comments-everywhere.owm at ad1a4680a, unchanged. A // comment on a line of its own and one that trails a statement are trivia: every statement reads as without them. A coordinate change of 'component Cup of Tea [0.79, 0.61] // a trailing comment on an element' changes only the numbers and keeps the comment; a removed link takes its trailing comment with its line, and the comment on the line after it stays.

steps.doc: A move of Cup of Tea is a replace-value of each number; the trailing comment is untouched.
The undo puts both numbers back.
Removing the link removes its line, its trailing comment with it; the comment line after it is kept.
The undo puts the line back, comment and all.
